_about: Live Supabase structure captured 2026-09-13 with supabase/catalog_capture.sql (v2: adds foreign_keys with ON DELETE/UPDATE actions and column_defaults). Structure only; password_hash_formats is a COUNT per hash prefix, never a hash. on_delete/on_update: a=no action, r=restrict, c=cascade, n=set null, d=set default.
